title: Zesty Irish Pepper Stew
description: A spicy and comforting Irish stew made with mixed peppers and cooked in a clay pot, perfect for a sick day. This dish is gluten-free friendly and features chewy textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb cubes with salt, black pepper, and dried thyme.
Heat a couple of tablespoons of oil in the molcajete over medium heat.
Sear the lamb cubes until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mixed peppers and cook until they start to soften.
Add the potatoes, tomato paste, chicken broth, irish stout, and browned lamb back to the molcajete.
Cover the molcajete with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
